4:   module Cop
5:     module Style
6:       # Transforms usages of a method call safeguarded by a non `nil`
7:       # check for the variable whose method is being called to
8:       # safe navigation (`&.`). If there is a method chain, all of the methods
9:       # in the chain need to be checked for safety, and all of the methods will
10:       # need to be changed to use safe navigation.
11:       #
12:       # The default for `ConvertCodeThatCanStartToReturnNil` is `false`.
13:       # When configured to `true`, this will
14:       # check for code in the format `!foo.nil? && foo.bar`. As it is written,
15:       # the return of this code is limited to `false` and whatever the return
16:       # of the method is. If this is converted to safe navigation,
17:       # `foo&.bar` can start returning `nil` as well as what the method
18:       # returns.
19:       #
20:       # The default for `MaxChainLength` is `2`.
21:       # We have limited the cop to not register an offense for method chains
22:       # that exceed this option's value.
23:       #
24:       # NOTE: This cop will recognize offenses but not autocorrect code when the
25:       # right hand side (RHS) of the `&&` statement is an `||` statement
26:       # (eg. `foo && (foo.bar? || foo.baz?)`). It can be corrected
27:       # manually by removing the `foo &&` and adding `&.` to each `foo` on the RHS.
28:       #
29:       # @safety
30:       #   Autocorrection is unsafe because if a value is `false`, the resulting
31:       #   code will have different behavior or raise an error.
32:       #
33:       #   [source,ruby]
34:       #   ----
35:       #   x = false
36:       #   x && x.foo  # return false
37:       #   x&.foo      # raises NoMethodError
38:       #   ----
39:       #
40:       # @example
41:       #   # bad
42:       #   foo.bar if foo
43:       #   foo.bar.baz if foo
44:       #   foo.bar(param1, param2) if foo
45:       #   foo.bar { |e| e.something } if foo
46:       #   foo.bar(param) { |e| e.something } if foo
47:       #
48:       #   foo.bar if !foo.nil?
49:       #   foo.bar unless !foo
50:       #   foo.bar unless foo.nil?
51:       #
52:       #   foo && foo.bar
53:       #   foo && foo.bar.baz
54:       #   foo && foo.bar(param1, param2)
55:       #   foo && foo.bar { |e| e.something }
56:       #   foo && foo.bar(param) { |e| e.something }
57:       #
58:       #   foo ? foo.bar : nil
59:       #   foo.nil? ? nil : foo.bar
60:       #   !foo.nil? ? foo.bar : nil
61:       #   !foo ? nil : foo.bar
62:       #
63:       #   # good
64:       #   foo&.bar
65:       #   foo&.bar&.baz
66:       #   foo&.bar(param1, param2)
67:       #   foo&.bar { |e| e.something }
68:       #   foo&.bar(param) { |e| e.something }
69:       #   foo && foo.bar.baz.qux # method chain with more than 2 methods
70:       #   foo && foo.nil? # method that `nil` responds to
71:       #
72:       #   # Method calls that do not use `.`
73:       #   foo && foo < bar
74:       #   foo < bar if foo
75:       #
76:       #   # When checking `foo&.empty?` in a conditional, `foo` being `nil` will actually
77:       #   # do the opposite of what the author intends.
78:       #   foo && foo.empty?
79:       #
80:       #   # This could start returning `nil` as well as the return of the method
81:       #   foo.nil? || foo.bar
82:       #   !foo || foo.bar
83:       #
84:       #   # Methods that are used on assignment, arithmetic operation or
85:       #   # comparison should not be converted to use safe navigation
86:       #   foo.baz = bar if foo
87:       #   foo.baz + bar if foo
88:       #   foo.bar > 2 if foo
89:       class SafeNavigation < Base # rubocop:disable Metrics/ClassLength
90:         include NilMethods

92:         extend AutoCorrector
93:         extend TargetRubyVersion

95:         MSG = 'Use safe navigation (`&.`) instead of checking if an object ' \
96:               'exists before calling the method.'

108:                   $_

141:         def on_if(node)
142:           return if allowed_if_condition?(node)
143: 
144:           checked_variable, receiver, method_chain, _method = extract_parts_from_if(node)
145:           return unless offending_node?(node, checked_variable, method_chain, receiver)
146: 
147:           body = extract_if_body(node)
148:           method_call = receiver.parent
149: 
150:           removal_ranges = [begin_range(node, body), end_range(node, body)]
151: 
152:           report_offense(node, method_chain, method_call, *removal_ranges) do |corrector|
153:             corrector.insert_before(method_call.loc.dot, '&') unless method_call.safe_navigation?
154:           end

157:         def on_and(node) # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength
158:           collect_and_clauses(node).each do |(lhs, lhs_operator_range), (rhs, _rhs_operator_range)|
159:             lhs_not_nil_check = not_nil_check?(lhs)
160:             lhs_receiver = lhs_not_nil_check || lhs
161:             rhs_receiver = find_matching_receiver_invocation(strip_begin(rhs), lhs_receiver)
162: 
163:             next if !cop_config['ConvertCodeThatCanStartToReturnNil'] && lhs_not_nil_check
164:             next unless offending_node?(node, lhs_receiver, rhs, rhs_receiver)
165: 
166:             # Since we are evaluating every clause in potentially a complex chain of `and` nodes,
167:             # we need to ensure that there isn't an object check happening
168:             lhs_method_chain = find_method_chain(lhs_receiver)
169:             next unless lhs_method_chain == lhs_receiver || lhs_not_nil_check
170: 
171:             report_offense(
172:               node,
173:               rhs, rhs_receiver,
174:               range_with_surrounding_space(range: lhs.source_range, side: :right),
175:               range_with_surrounding_space(range: lhs_operator_range, side: :right),
176:               offense_range: range_between(lhs.source_range.begin_pos, rhs.source_range.end_pos)
177:             )
178:           end
179:         end

181:         def report_offense(node, rhs, rhs_receiver, *removal_ranges, offense_range: node)
182:           add_offense(offense_range) do |corrector|
183:             # If the RHS is an `or` we cannot safely autocorrect because in order to remove
184:             # the non-nil check we need to add safe-navs to all clauses where the receiver is used
185:             next if and_with_rhs_or?(node)
186: 
187:             removal_ranges.each { |range| corrector.remove(range) }
188:             yield corrector if block_given?
189: 
190:             handle_comments(corrector, node, rhs)
191: 
192:             add_safe_nav_to_all_methods_in_chain(corrector, rhs_receiver, rhs)
193:           end
194:         end

198:         def find_method_chain(node)
199:           return node unless node&.parent&.call_type?
200: 
201:           find_method_chain(node.parent)
202:         end

204:         def collect_and_clauses(node)
205:           # Collect the lhs, operator and rhs of all `and` nodes
206:           # `and` nodes can be nested and can contain `begin` nodes
207:           # This gives us a source-ordered list of clauses that is then used to look
208:           # for matching receivers as well as operator locations for offense and corrections
209:           node.each_descendant(:and)
210:               .inject(and_parts(node)) { |nodes, and_node| concat_nodes(nodes, and_node) }
211:               .sort_by { |a| a.is_a?(RuboCop::AST::Node) ? a.source_range.begin_pos : a.begin_pos }
212:               .each_slice(2)
213:               .each_cons(2)
214:         end

216:         def concat_nodes(nodes, and_node)
217:           return nodes if and_node.each_ancestor(:block).any?
218: 
219:           nodes.concat(and_parts(and_node))
220:         end

222:         def and_parts(node)
223:           parts = [node.loc.operator]
224:           parts << node.rhs unless and_inside_begin?(node.rhs)
225:           parts << node.lhs unless node.lhs.and_type? || and_inside_begin?(node.lhs)
226:           parts
227:         end

229:         def offending_node?(node, lhs_receiver, rhs, rhs_receiver) # rubocop:disable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity
230:           assessment = assemble_navigation_assessment(node, lhs_receiver, rhs, rhs_receiver)
231:           return false unless assessment[:receivers_aligned]
232:           return false if assessment[:unless_modifier_block]
233:           return false if assessment[:chain_too_long]
234:           return false if assessment[:unsafe_method]
235:           return false if assessment[:empty_predicate]
236: 
237:           true
238:         end

240:         def use_var_only_in_unless_modifier?(node, variable)

245:           if node.ternary?

252:         def handle_comments(corrector, node, method_call)
253:           comments = comments(node)
254:           return if comments.empty?
255: 
256:           corrector.insert_before(method_call, "#{comments.map(&:text).join("\n")}\n")

259:         def comments(node)
260:           relevant_comment_ranges(node).each.with_object([]) do |range, comments|
261:             comments.concat(processed_source.each_comment_in_lines(range).to_a)

265:         def relevant_comment_ranges(node)
266:           # Get source lines ranges inside the if node that aren't inside an inner node
267:           # Comments inside an inner node should remain attached to that node, and not
268:           # moved.
269:           begin_pos = node.loc.first_line
270:           end_pos = node.loc.last_line
271: 
272:           node.child_nodes.each.with_object([]) do |child, ranges|
273:             ranges << (begin_pos...child.loc.first_line)
274:             begin_pos = child.loc.last_line
275:           end << (begin_pos...end_pos)
276:         end

278:         def allowed_if_condition?(node)
279:           node.else? || node.elsif?
280:         end

282:         def extract_parts_from_if(node)
283:           variable, receiver =
284:             if node.ternary?
285:               ternary_safe_navigation_candidate(node)
286:             else
287:               modifier_if_safe_navigation_candidate(node)
288:             end

290:           checked_variable, matching_receiver, method = extract_common_parts(receiver, variable)
291: 
292:           matching_receiver = nil if receiver && LOGIC_JUMP_KEYWORDS.include?(receiver.type)
293: 
294:           [checked_variable, matching_receiver, receiver, method]
295:         end

297:         def extract_common_parts(method_chain, checked_variable)
298:           matching_receiver = find_matching_receiver_invocation(method_chain, checked_variable)
299: 
300:           method = matching_receiver.parent if matching_receiver
301: 
302:           [checked_variable, matching_receiver, method]
303:         end

305:         def find_matching_receiver_invocation(method_chain, checked_variable)
306:           return nil unless method_chain.respond_to?(:receiver)
307: 
308:           receiver = method_chain.receiver
309: 
310:           return receiver if receiver == checked_variable
311: 
312:           find_matching_receiver_invocation(receiver, checked_variable)
313:         end

315:         def chain_length(method_chain, method)
316:           method.each_ancestor(:send).inject(0) do |total, ancestor|
317:             break total + 1 if ancestor == method_chain
318: 
319:             total + 1
320:           end

323:         def unsafe_method_used?(method_chain, method)
324:           return true if unsafe_method?(method)
325: 
326:           method.each_ancestor(:send).any? do |ancestor|
327:             break true unless config.for_cop('Lint/SafeNavigationChain')['Enabled']
328: 
329:             break true if unsafe_method?(ancestor)
330:             break true if nil_methods.include?(ancestor.method_name)
331:             break false if ancestor == method_chain
332:           end

335:         def unsafe_method?(send_node)
336:           negated?(send_node) ||
337:             send_node.assignment? ||
338:             (!send_node.dot? && !send_node.safe_navigation?)
339:         end

341:         def negated?(send_node)
342:           if method_called?(send_node)
343:             negated?(send_node.parent)
344:           else
345:             send_node.send_type? && send_node.method?(:!)
346:           end
347:         end

349:         def method_called?(send_node)
350:           send_node&.parent&.send_type?
351:         end

354:           range_between(node.source_range.begin_pos, method_call.source_range.begin_pos)

361:         def add_safe_nav_to_all_methods_in_chain(corrector,
362:                                                  start_method,
363:                                                  method_chain)
364:           start_method.each_ancestor do |ancestor|
365:             break unless %i[send block].include?(ancestor.type)
366:             next unless ancestor.send_type?
367:             next if ancestor.safe_navigation?
